svg.title: All-Optical Dynamic Channel Attention with Broad-Area VCSOA
svg.desc: Local vector reconstruction of the supplied mathematical pipeline, using the established blue/orange/green project style. The source topology and equations are retained. All text is outlined with uniform scaling. Pictorial textures are native Bezier contours. Before/after field thumbnails show the same normalized spatial example under the channel-scalar approximation. Polarization preparation, beam shaping, routing and output control rejection are implicit in this functional schematic; inference is read in the settled frame-based quasi-CW regime. No new experimental or numerical results are represented.
